user_message: Why can't an ordinary light microscope resolve arbitrarily small details just by increasing magnification? Give one quantitative rule of thumb and explain what “empty magnification” means.
allowed_evidence: For incoherent imaging through a circular aperture, lateral resolution is commonly estimated by d ≈ 0.61λ/NA. Enlarging an image after spatial detail has been lost does not restore that information.
public_rubric: Uses the supplied resolution relation correctly.
Explains information loss in concrete terms.
